title: Comparative Analysis of In Vitro Pumps Used in Cardiovascular Investigations: Focus on Flow Generation Principles and Characteristics of Generated Flows
purpose: Classify mechanisms, generated flows and applications.
takeaway: Use its taxonomy; verify individual pump claims in primary papers.

title: Design of an In Vitro Mock Circulatory Loop to Reproduce Patient-Specific Vascular Conditions: Toward Precision Medicine
architecture: Servo / ball-screw piston, LV chamber, two passive valves, Windkessel
purpose: Supply patient-specific pulsatile flow to vascular models.
takeaway: Connect prescribed flow, chamber pressure, hydraulic force and actuator sizing; separate afterload tuning.
conditions: Abstract reports 2–5 L/min and 40–70 bpm; waveform routine separately exercised at 1–6 L/min and 40–80 bpm.

title: In vitro Tools for the Personalised Haemodynamic Assessment of Aortic Dissection
category: Detailed model / same platform as F19
architecture: Piston plus lumped valve, passage and afterload circuit
purpose: Design and apply an aortic-dissection experimental platform.
takeaway: Most useful derivation: resistance, inertia, nonlinear losses, force and Windkessel. Printed tapered-passage Eq 2.5 needs correction.
conditions: Thesis; not an independent replication of F19.
locator: Chapter 2, pp 91–100, particularly Fig 2.3 and Eqs 2.1–2.12

title: A new pulsatile volumetric device with biomorphic valves for the in vitro study of the cardiovascular system
takeaway: Direct predecessor; valve backflow and losses need measurement.
conditions: 5 and 6 L/min; 60–80 bpm; 8 h reliability test reported.
access: Primary abstract; full equations not accessed

title: Flow pumping system for physiological waveforms
purpose: Superimpose pulsation on separately supplied mean flow.
takeaway: Piston displacement is not total delivered cardiac output.
conditions: 54.5 mm bore; 100 mm travel; frequency response depends on tubing.

title: New pulsatile hydrostatic pressure bioreactor for vascular tissue-engineered constructs
architecture: Piston classification from M24; hardware unverified
purpose: Apply cyclic pressure to vascular constructs.
takeaway: Pressure stimulation does not establish net circulatory delivery.

title: Successful Development of Small Diameter Tissue-Engineering Vascular Vessels by Our Novel Integrally Designed Pulsatile Perfusion-Based Bioreactor
architecture: Linear-motor piston with flexible sealing interface
takeaway: Useful sealing and sensing concept; different delivery scale.
conditions: Approximately 10 mL per extension; actuator travel 0.1–48 mm.

title: In vitro cardiovascular system emulator (bioreactor) for the simulation of normal and diseased conditions with and without mechanical circulatory support
purpose: Emulate cardiac conditions with and without support devices.
takeaway: Supports separating chamber roles and valve timing.
conditions: Normal and dysfunction scenarios; no force values adopted.
access: Primary abstract; full equations not accessed

title: Sliding mode control for the Frank–Starling response of a piston pump mock ventricle
architecture: Piston mock ventricle with pressure control
takeaway: Control objective differs from prescribing a fixed flow waveform.
conditions: Experimental controller evaluation reported; equations unverified.

title: A High Performance Pulsatile Pump for Aortic Flow Experiments in 3-Dimensional Models
purpose: Drive aortic models under demanding hydraulic loads.
takeaway: Useful waveform-performance comparison; full sizing equations inaccessible.
conditions: 850 mL/s capability reported; not a mean-flow specification.

title: Structure and motion design of a mock circulatory test rig
architecture: Pistons displace surrounding water to move ventricular sacs
takeaway: Volume trajectory gives piston travel, velocity and acceleration; indirect fluid contact differs from our plunger.
conditions: 50 mm piston design example; sizing assumptions are not validated limits.

title: High-Versatility Left Ventricle Pump and Aortic Mock Circulatory Loop Development for Patient-Specific Hemodynamic In Vitro Analysis
architecture: LV piston platform also used in B24
takeaway: Relevant platform family; use accessible B24 for implementation context.
conditions: No numerical envelope adopted from partial access.
access: Partial primary abstract; platform confirmed in B24

title: An In Vitro Circulatory Loop Model of the Pediatric Right Ventricular Outflow Tract as a Platform for Valve Evaluation
architecture: Piston classification from M24; primary hardware details unverified
purpose: Evaluate valves in a paediatric RV outflow model.
takeaway: Useful right-side test objectives; adult sizing cannot be transferred.
conditions: Regurgitation and pressure-gradient assessment; no pump sizing adopted.

title: A hybrid mock circulatory loop integrated with a LED-PIV system for the investigation of AAA compliant phantoms
category: AAA phantom / PIV / hybrid boundary load
architecture: LV piston plus actively controlled afterload
takeaway: Measured flow drives a numerical Windkessel and pressure controller.
conditions: Closely relevant EVAR boundary interface; not pump-force validation.
